lines.text: The Holy Spirit tells the church at Antioch to set apart Barnabas and Saul, and they lay hands on them.
Sent by the Holy Spirit, Barnabas and Saul sail from Seleucia to Crete and preach in Salamis with John.
At Paphos, the proconsul Sergius Paulus summons Barnabas and Saul, but the sorcerer Elymas opposes them.
Filled with the Holy Spirit, Paul tells Elymas he will be blind forever, and darkness comes over him.
The proconsul sees what happened and believes, astonished at the teaching about the Lord.
